facts.headline: Napoleon stole this gate's crown — and lost it eight years later
facts.hook: Napoleon stole the Brandenburg Gate's bronze Quadriga in 1806 — Prussian troops found it still in its crates in Paris, eight years later.

facts.headline: A Communist state built a giant sphere — and accidentally gave it a cross
facts.hook: Sunlight hits the TV Tower just right to form a giant cross — Berliners call it the Pope's Revenge.

facts.headline: You can literally stand above German lawmakers' heads
facts.hook: The Reichstag's glass dome lets visitors walk a spiral ramp directly above the parliamentary chamber below.

facts.headline: The world's longest open-air gallery is 1.3km of the Berlin Wall
facts.hook: 118 artists painted 1.3km of the Berlin Wall within months of it falling — the longest open-air gallery on Earth.

facts.headline: Berliners nicknamed their bombed church 'the hollow tooth' — and kept it that way on purpose
facts.hook: RAF bombs gutted this church in 1943 — Berliners nicknamed the ruin 'the hollow tooth' and kept it standing on purpose.

facts.headline: Berliners voted to keep a giant airport completely empty forever
facts.hook: Berliners voted in 2014 to ban all construction on this former airport — now a park roughly the size of Central Park.

facts.headline: Egypt has been asking for this 3,300-year-old bust back for over a century
facts.hook: This 3,300-year-old bust has sat in Berlin since 1913 — Egypt has demanded it back for over a century, even Hitler refused.
